acceptanceCriteria.text: Static revision HTML can render a structured review-result fixture without changing its semantics.
Verdict, blocking findings, confidence, inspected inputs and unknowns are visible.
A GitHub Check projection contract is implemented/tested for APPROVE, CHANGES_REQUIRED and INCONCLUSIVE.
Check identity is exact-head scoped and contains a Review Pages revision link.
No raw model transcript or private reasoning is written to Pages or GitHub.
Projection tests use fixtures and remain independent of live LLM execution.
Auto-merge and remediation are not introduced.

issue.title: feat: project autonomous review results into Review Pages and GitHub Checks
